Class Offset

java.lang.Object
com.yetnt.utils.tuple.Pair<Integer,Integer>
com.yetnt.utils.tuple.SamePair<Integer>
com.j3d.engine.math.convert.Offset
public class Offset extends SamePair<Integer>
A simple immutable class which stores an X and Y offset when converting between ScreenPoint and CartesianPoint using their offset overloads.
Author:
Lehlogonolo Poole
